review_note: Reviewed all 124 chronological originals and enlarged hands, launcher and leg registration. The lancer widens its footing, lowers then raises the launcher across the chest, and settles into a bent-knee held guard. Two arms, stable grips and the attached winch/net bundles persist. Selected 15 original transition phases over 675 ms, trimming the long terminal hold; runtime holds original 64. No reversed frames, interpolation or duplicate padding.
